measurement.candidate_grammar: ordinary locator candidates matching ^R?\d+(?:\.\d+)+\b after source-role classification and table exclusion
measurement.rationale: ACI structural locators are chapter-qualified; chapter 0 is not a publication chapter, while decimal engineering expressions beginning with 0 repeatedly collide with the permissive locator grammar.

proposed_discriminator.rule: For ordinary Code/Commentary locator promotion, reject candidates whose chapter component is 0 before duplicate selection and structural-node construction.
proposed_discriminator.scope: ordinary locator promotion only; table recognition is unchanged
proposed_discriminator.expected_effect: Remove this measured false-positive family without title inference or engineering-semantic reconstruction.
